title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 162 ]

blocks.text: Professional athletes do not agree on what their roles should be. Some star players believe that their role is to be a great player, not a role model for young people. They insist, “We’re not paid to be role models.” They strongly believe that what they do in their private lives is their own business. On the other hand, other star players disagree. They maintain that sports stars are role models for people even though they may not want to be. They say, “We do not choose to be role models. We are chosen. Our choice is whether to be good role models or bad ones.”

readingSentences.english: Professional athletes do not agree on what their roles should be.
readingSentences.korean: 프로 선수들은 자신의 역할이 무엇이어야 하는지에 대해 의견이 갈린다.

readingSentences.english: Some star players believe that their role is to be a great player, not a role model for young people.
readingSentences.korean: 일부 스타 선수들은 자신의 역할이 젊은이들의 본보기가 되는 것이 아니라 훌륭한 선수가 되는 것이라고 믿는다.

readingSentences.english: They insist, “We’re not paid to be role models.”
readingSentences.korean: 그들은 “우리는 본보기가 되라고 돈을 받는 게 아니다.”라고 주장한다.

readingSentences.english: They strongly believe that what they do in their private lives is their own business.
readingSentences.korean: 그들은 사생활에서 무엇을 하든 자기 일이라고 굳게 믿는다.

readingSentences.english: On the other hand, other star players disagree.
readingSentences.korean: 반면 다른 스타 선수들은 이에 동의하지 않는다.

readingSentences.english: They maintain that sports stars are role models for people even though they may not want to be.
readingSentences.korean: 그들은 스포츠 스타는 원하지 않더라도 사람들의 본보기라고 주장한다.

readingSentences.english: They say, “We do not choose to be role models. We are chosen. Our choice is whether to be good role models or bad ones.”
readingSentences.korean: 그들은 말한다. “우리가 본보기가 되기로 선택하는 것이 아니라, 본보기로 선택되는 것이다. 우리가 고를 수 있는 것은 좋은 본보기가 될지 나쁜 본보기가 될지뿐이다.”
